span.p:
All fast-path signals for one unit
input stage, or one output sentence

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 1 — map labels to actions
for each label: specific > wildcard > default_action
signal action = most severe across its labels

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
STEP 2
score_kind?
ADR-012

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
detection kind
higher = worse
tier1_*, tier2_*, numeric_claims,
cost_*, loop_guard, conv_tracker
band logic never applies

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
confidence kind
higher = better
fast_consistency, rag_grounding
compare score to thresholds

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
score ≥ tau_high
drop signal
not firing

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tau_low ≤ score < tau_high
borderline band
action becomes ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
score < tau_low
use mapped action
as-is

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 3
most severe action
across surviving signals
BLOCK > ESCALATE > EDIT > PASS

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PASS
no signals survived

signal actually editable?
has span, or stage = output_sentence
ADR-015

redact at pii.* spans
soften hallucination.* claim
re-run tier1_pii once as a guard

promote signal to ESCALATE
safe upgrade
